reconciliation_439_vs_451.explanation: Both use the same containment test (head SHA is not an independent tip under `git merge-base --independent` over all non-ancestor-of-main heads). The 451 in the earlier report was computed over the pre-deletion set of 651 non-ancestor names, which still included the 12 exact-duplicate names (each pointed at the same SHA as a retained twin that is itself contained). Those 12 were proposed deletions in #984 and were deleted in batch 1, so #984's preserved list (and this re-run on live refs) counts 439. Same cause: the report's 430 contained-in-cycle76 figure = 417 preserved + those 12 + cycle76 counted as its own ancestor; and the report's prefix breakdown (chatgpt 472, sum 651) was over the same 651-name set — the correct preserved non-ancestor figure is 639 (636 + 3 never-delete), chatgpt 460.
reconciliation_439_vs_451.not_in_either_count: grokbot-branch-cleanup-manifest-20261102 and grokbot-branch-cleanup-execution-record-20261102 were created after #984's snapshot; both are ancestors of main, so neither is in the non-ancestor set.

method.containment: For each live non-ancestor-of-main branch whose head is not an independent tip, `git merge-base --is-ancestor <head> <container>` was run against never-delete branches first (cycle76, #650 head, #707 head), then other independent tips. Independent tips are never candidates. A branch is a candidate only if its container is a never-delete branch.
method.name_reference_scan: Every blob in every live branch head (678 heads incl. main, cycle76, #650/#707 heads, grokbot-m7-production-ledger and all *-ledger/approval branches; 13,597 distinct blobs) was tokenised on [A-Za-z0-9_.-] (so `origin/<name>`, `compare/a...<name>` and URL forms match; names containing '/' matched by substring) and checked for an exact branch name. Excluded only the pure inventories that list every branch: data/maintenance/github_branch_heads_2026-11-02.json, data/maintenance/branch_cleanup_manifest_2026-11-02.json, data/maintenance/branch_cleanup_execution_2026-11-02.json, docs/archive/BRANCH_CLEANUP_2026-11-02.md.
method.github_text_scan: Titles and bodies of all 985 issues/PRs (every state) and all 146 issue/PR conversation comments; 0 PR review comments exist.
method.other_checks: 0 open PRs; 0 protected branches; 0 rulesets; PR base-branch use; head author/committer date vs 2026-10-26 (7 days); every candidate's recorded PR head SHA equals its branch head.
method.keep_rule: Any name reference, recent head, PR-base use, non-never-delete container, open PR, or shared SHA => KEEP.

execution_preconditions: re-verify each name+SHA via git ls-remote immediately before each delete; stop on mismatch
